as_told.title: Charles Manson as an MK Ultra subject

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he thinks Charles Manson, the cult leader in Los Angeles in the late 1960s, was a patient of MK Ultra, a secret mind-control research programme run by the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency. In one telling he credits a friend, the writer Tom O'Neill, with documenting it and names a doctor, Jolly West, while in another he just says Manson was probably such a patient. If true, it would tie a famous crime to secret government experiments.
